verifications.claim: For the 2026 tax season, taxpayers can request an automatic extension to file their federal income tax return until October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Generally, we can’t extend the due date of your return for more than 6 months (October 15, 2026, for most calendar year taxpayers)'; R4: 'An extension gives people until October 15 to file'; R6: 'extension to file their federal income tax return until Oct. 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the 6-month extension to October 15, 2026, for 2025 returns due in 2026.

verifications.claim: The extension request must be filed by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'File Form 4868 by the due date... April 15, 2026'; R2: 'by the April 15 deadline'; R6: 'request the extension by April 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm the extension request deadline is April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: The extension request must be filed using Form 4868.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'You don’t need to file Form 4868 if you make a payment using our electronic payment options'; R2: 'make a tax payment online and choose “extension”... automatically submits Form 4868. You won’t need additional forms'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict the claim by stating electronic payment alone grants extension without filing Form 4868.

verifications.claim: An extension grants more time to file, not to pay.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Form 4868 doesn’t extend the time to pay taxes'; R4: 'the extension is only for filing a return and not for extra time to pay'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported across multiple IRS sources.

verifications.claim: Estimated taxes owed are still due by April 15, 2026, to avoid penalties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'you’ll owe interest... You may also be charged penalties'; R4: 'pay taxes due on April 15, 2026, to avoid penalties and interest'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm taxes owed due April 15 to avoid penalties/interest.

verifications.claim: IRS Free File can be used to submit Form 4868 electronically at no cost.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Several companies offer free e-filing of Form 4868 through the Free File Program'; R2: 'file Form 4868 via IRS Free File... at no cost'

verifications.claim: Paying all or part of estimated taxes via IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or EFTPS and selecting "Extension" as the reason avoids the need to file a separate Form 4868.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'indicate that the payment is for an extension using... IRS Direct Pay... debit card... EFTPS... You don’t need to file Form 4868'; R6: 'Pay online and select “extension.”... IRS Direct Pay... Electronic Federal Tax Payment System... no additional forms'

verifications.claim: A paper Form 4868 mailed to the IRS must be postmarked by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'mail Form 4868, but it must be postmarked by April 15'; R1: 'File Form 4868 by the due date... April 15, 2026' (implies postmark rule for paper)
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states postmark requirement; R1 confirms due date.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers must pay 90% of their total tax liability by April 15, 2026 to avoid estimated payment penalties.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source mentions 90% specifically for 'estimated payment penalties'; R1 mentions 90% for reasonable cause on late payment penalty (excluding estimated tax).

verifications.claim: U.S. citizens living outside the country may receive an automatic two-month extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'you’re out of the country... allowed 2 extra months to file'; R3: 'U.S. citizens... outside the U.S.... two-month extension'; R6: 'U.S. citizens... outside... automatic two-month extension'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported for U.S. citizens/residents out of country.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers in specific declared disaster areas may have postponed deadlines.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'If you were affected by a disaster... See www.irs.gov/DisasterRelief'; R5: 'tax relief for... affected by Winter Storm Fern... deadlines postponed'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm disaster area extensions.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers impacted by Winter Storm Fern in Tennessee may have postponed deadlines
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'IRS announces tax relief for taxpayers impacted by Winter Storm Fern in Tennessee; various deadlines postponed to May 22, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: R5 title and content directly match the specific disaster.
